policy: Short factual summaries only; no copied tutorials, forum posts, GTA files, or mod assets.

sources.summary: A community troubleshooting thread identifies timecycle_mods_4.xml and redmist sections as controlling a rampage screen effect. This supports, but does not independently prove, the task-defined timecycle 4 kill-effect route.
A community mod page installs timecycle_mods_4.xml under the timecycle path to alter a screen effect, supporting the file-family mapping.
A current community guide maps timecycle XML and visualsettings.dat to lighting, sky, fog, exposure, post-FX, and weather controls.
The official JPEXS project supports SWF-to-XML export and XML import. Redux Maker invokes it externally and does not vendor or link its code.
The official command-line documentation records automated SWF export and import operations, supporting an external-process integration rather than a bundled native GFX writer.
The upstream BGE small English embedding model is MIT licensed and suitable for sentence embedding used by the local classifier head.
The upstream Qwen3 GGUF release provides a compact Apache-2.0 model compatible with the local llama.cpp planner route.
The upstream SmolVLM2 model card identifies an Apache-2.0 vision-language model usable for local prompt/image consistency checks.
The upstream SSD-1B model card records an Apache-2.0 diffusion model distributed through the Hugging Face registry for local image generation.

localEvidence.conclusion: Multiple independently named local Redux sample folders contain timecycle_mods_4.xml in kill-effect/effect-oriented paths, consistent with community research. No raw content was copied into this repository.
